name: PEKAT
recent: Pekat 将于2026年12月1日从 ACE Market 转板至 Main Market。公司近期公布2026财年第三季业绩，净利按年增长约27%至RM13.04百万，非太阳能业务表现较强。此外，公司宣布私下配售最多10%新股，并获PD数据中心项目额外三份合约。
notable: Pekat 获得PD数据中心项目额外三份合约。
间接持股60%的子公司EPE Switchgear以RM30,575,955.32收购六块永久工业地。
risks: 私下配售最多10%新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
董事 Datin Shelina Binti Razaly Wahi 于2026年10月6日出售20,000股普通股。
公司延长私下配售所得款项的使用期限。
earnings: 2026财年第三季（截至2026年6月30日）营收为RM175.43百万，按季增长4.5%，按年增长38.1%；净利为RM14.19百万，按季增长14.2%，按年增长28.8%；净利率为8.1%，高于上一季的7.4%。

recent_en: Pekat will transfer its listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market on 1 December 2026. The company recently reported 3Q 2026 net profit up about 27% year-on-year to RM13.04 million, driven by stronger non-solar segments. It also announced a private placement of up to 10% new shares and secured three additional contracts for the PD data centre project.
notable_en: Pekat secured three additional contracts for the PD data centre project.
Pekat proposed a private placement of up to 66,156,820 new shares, representing up to 10% of the enlarged share capital.
Indirect 60%-owned subsidiary EPE Switchgear is acquiring six freehold industrial land parcels for RM30,575,955.32.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
Director Datin Shelina Binti Razaly Wahi disposed of 20,000 ordinary shares on 6 October 2026.
The company extended the timeframe for utilising proceeds from its private placement.
earnings_en: For 3Q 2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was RM175.43 million, up 4.5% QoQ and 38.1% YoY; net income was RM14.19 million, up 14.2% QoQ and 28.8% YoY; net margin was 8.1%, higher than 7.4% in the previous quarter.
